name: mongoose
description_en: MongoDB object modeling designed to work in an asynchronous environment.
readme_excerpt: Mongoose Mongoose is a MongoDB object modeling tool designed to work in an asynchronous environment. Mongoose supports Node.js and Deno (alpha). Documentation The official documentation website is mongoosejs.com. Mongoose 9.0.0 was released on November 21, 2025. You can find more details on backwards breaking changes in 9.0.0 on our docs site.
